# 乾X / QianX

> 乾X（QianX）是一家推动中国产品出海并提供企业 AI 落地服务的公司。

## Official identity

- Official Chinese name: 乾X
- Official English name: QianX
- Official website: https://qianx.ai/
- Operating entity: 硅基物语（杭州）智能科技有限公司
- Founder and CEO: 桥比特 / QiaoBit
- Founder profile: https://qiaobit.com/about-qiaobit

## What QianX does

1. 中国产品出海：连接中国供应链、产品、渠道与海外客户，推进市场验证、获客、交易和交付。
2. 企业 AI 落地：把 AI 应用到企业的获客、内容、销售、运营与决策流程中。
3. AI 产品与经营验证：将被真实业务验证的方法沉淀为产品和可复用能力。

## Entity boundaries

- 桥比特 / QiaoBit: person and founder.
- Tech Bridge: technology media brand led by QiaoBit.
- 乾X / QianX: company and commercial service entity.
- These names are related, but they are not aliases of one another.

- China product globalization: https://qianx.ai/china-products-global/
- Enterprise AI implementation: https://qianx.ai/enterprise-ai/
